features.name: Oath Spells
features.description:
You gain oath spells at the listed paladin levels. They are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells.

| Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | protection from evil and good, sanctuary |
| 5th | lesser restoration, zone of truth |
| 9th | beacon of hope, dispel magic |
| 13th | freedom of movement, guardian of faith |
| 17th | commune, flame strike |

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Sacred Weapon.** Action: imbue one held weapon for 1 minute. Add CHA mod to attack rolls (min +1). Weapon emits bright light 20 ft + dim 20 ft. Becomes magical if it wasn't.

**Turn the Unholy.** Action: each fiend or undead within 30 ft that can see/hear you makes WIS save or is turned for 1 minute (or until it takes damage).

payload.name: Sacred Weapon
payload.description: Imbue weapon: +CHA to attacks, bright light 20 ft, magical for 1 min.

payload.name: Turn the Unholy
payload.description: Fiends and undead within 30 ft make WIS save or are turned for 1 min.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of a *protection from evil and good* spell.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: At 20th level, as an action, you emanate an aura of sunlight for 1 minute. Bright light 30 ft + dim 30 ft. Enemy creatures starting their turn in the bright light take 10 radiant damage. Advantage on saves vs fiend/undead spells. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Holy Nimbus
payload.description: Emanate sunlight aura for 1 min: 10 radiant damage to enemies in bright light, advantage on saves vs fiend/undead spells.
